message.text: The compiled React frontend is embedded via `go:embed` of `dist/*` and served by Echo static middleware with SPA fallback in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`.

q27.
go:embed of `dist/*` served via Echo static + SPA fallback; server/router/frontend/frontend.go

`//go:embed dist/*` loads the built assets into `embeddedFiles`. `FrontendService.Serve` mounts them with `middleware.StaticWithConfig` and `spaFallbackMiddleware` so unmatched UI routes get `index.html`.
